texts.li: A herd of {COUNT} {BEAST} is crossing the colony's land, walking steady for the far edge. {A_nameDef} has been watching them, and says the hunters could take one or two before they're gone. A herd that size can turn on whoever goes after it, too.

[big] {COUNT} {BEAST} are walking across the colony's land in a long line. {A_nameDef} wants the council's word: take the biggest, take a few for the stores, or let them pass. Hunted, a beast of a herd like that can turn on the hunter.

[lowtech] The {BEAST} are crossing, {COUNT} of them, the way they cross every few seasons on their way to other grass. {A_nameDef} is ready to go out after them. The old hunters' rule is to take from the back of the herd and never too many; even so, a hunted beast may turn.

[!lowtech] A herd of {COUNT} {BEAST} is moving across the colony's land toward the far edge, unhurried. {A_nameDef} wants the council's word before the herd is out of range. A beast of the herd, hunted, may turn on whoever is hunting it.

li.label: Take a few for the stores
li.outcome: A few of the grown {BEAST} are marked for the colony's hunters, who go out after them before the herd is gone.

outcomes.li: [lowtech] A few of the grown {BEAST} are marked for the hunters, the old way, never too many, and the hunters go out after them.

li.label: Take the biggest one
li.outcome: The biggest of the {BEAST} is marked for the colony's hunters. The rest of the herd will be left to cross.

li.label: Let them cross
li.outcome: The {BEAST} are left to cross the colony's land in peace, on their way to wherever they're going.
